summary: Iter 220cj - Tested 5 engineer-app features: Queue Preview Modal, EngineerNewJob hours/minutes dropdowns, New Customer modal validation, Equipment CSV buttons, and Site Equipment Picker. Fixed a bug where onPreview was not passed to virtualized list rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 iter 220cj features are working. Fixed a bug in EngineerQueue.js where onPreview was missing from the virtualized list rowProps (line 826-831). The fix adds onPreview to the rowProps so View details buttons work when queue has >30 items.

1_queue_preview_modal.details: View details button opens modal showing site name, address, fault description, estimated time, notes count. Close and Allocate to me buttons work.
1_queue_preview_modal.fix_applied: Added onPreview to virtualized list rowProps in EngineerQueue.js

2_newjob_hours_minutes.details: Two select dropdowns for hours (0-8) and minutes (0/15/30/45) replace the single number input. data-testid='newjob-estimated-hours' and 'newjob-estimated-minutes' present.

3_new_customer_validation.details: Companies House lookup block present with search input. 5 mandatory fields (Name, Email, Phone, Site Name, Site Address) show 'Required' errors. Email format validation shows 'Enter a valid email' error.

4_equipment_csv_buttons.details: Template download button (data-testid='equipment-csv-download') and Import CSV button (data-testid='equipment-csv-import') visible. Hidden file input present.

5_site_equipment_picker.details: From site button (data-testid='machines-load-from-site-btn') opens picker modal with search input, Select all toggle, and Add button. Shows 'No equipment for this site yet' when site has no equipment.

api_tests.queue_preview: GET /api/svc/engineer/queue/{case_id}/preview - 401 without auth, 404 for nonexistent case
api_tests.site_equipment: GET /api/svc/engineer/jobs/{case_id}/site-equipment - 401 without auth, 404 for nonexistent case
api_tests.bulk_attach: POST /api/svc/engineer/jobs/{case_id}/machines/bulk-from-site - 401 without auth, 404 for nonexistent case, 400 for empty body
